about: Which providers can search the web with the key the person already gave, keyed by the models.dev provider id; models.dev has no such field. kind search_api: a search endpoint of its own, called without a model. Each row names its source, the date it was checked, and the phrases that source must still contain: scripts/check_web_search_sources.py checks them on the model catalog's schedule and opens an issue when one is gone.
